source.palette: scripts/gen-theme.py (generates src/renderer/src/styles/envi-theme.css; never edit the generated file)

display.purpose: Home headline stating what is due.

headword.purpose: The word on study and detail; 2.25rem below sm.

term.purpose: A word named inside rows, lists and recaps.

label.purpose: Metadata, skills, key hints; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: shadow-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Tooltips (ink fill in light, cream in dark).

shadows.name: shadow-card-ring
shadows.purpose: Hairline ring where a border cannot be used.

shadows.name: focus-shadow
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus: paper gap then indigo.

motion.name: seal-press
motion.purpose: Seal ink-down: scale(1.6) rotate(-10deg) opacity .25 → scale(.95) rotate(-3deg) at 55% → lands at rotate(-3deg). Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: study-stamp-hold
motion.purpose: Study card holds after a Good rating so the pressed seal is seen; 240ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: recap-stagger
motion.purpose: Finish recap stamps grown words one after another.

motion.name: btn-spring
motion.purpose: Button release over 450ms; press is scale(.975) in 60ms ease-out.

motion.name: color-ease
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour changes on buttons.

knownGaps: No giấy điệp paper material: flat warm ground, no shell-mica sheen or fibre; only the seal carries ink grain.
No carved key-block framing: hairline divisions, not woodblock-cut borders.
The 3D garden and activity scenes still render outside the print world (soft-shaded low-poly).
Home "episode waiting" ink-block row implemented but not visually verified in review captures.

components.css: .ds-rail { width:224px; padding:12px 8px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; background:var(--rail-bg, #1d1915); color:var(--rail-muted, #b9ae9c); font:400 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-logo { font:700 20px 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; color:var(--rail-fg, #f3ece0); padding:4px 8px 14px; } .ds-rail-add { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:36px; padding:0 10px; margin-bottom:12px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:var(--pigment-son, #b3342a); color:var(--on-brand, #fffaf2); font:600 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .12s; } .ds-rail-add span { flex:1; text-align:left; } .ds-rail-add kbd { font:500 12px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; opacity:.75; } .ds-rail-add:hover { background:var(--fill-brand-hover, #9a2b22); } .ds-rail-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:32px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:4px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 60ms, color 60ms; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background:var(--rail-hover, #2c2620); color:var(--rail-fg, #f3ece0); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #7d9bd6; outline-offset:-2px; } .ds-rail-dot { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:2px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px currentColor; } .ds-rail-active { background:var(--rail-active, #3a322a); color:var(--rail-fg, #f3ece0); font-weight:500; } .ds-rail-active .ds-rail-dot { color:var(--pigment-hoe, #e3b12f); }

components.name: Due Words Row
components.description: Sophora-washed row of due words, each with a thirsty seal; the whole row starts review.
components.css: .ds-due { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; width:560px; padding:12px 16px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-warning, #d8b04a) 60%, transparent); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-warning, #f6e5ad) 50%, transparent); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-due:hover { background:var(--bg-warning, #f6e5ad); } .ds-due:hover .ds-due-arrow { transform:translateX(2px); } .ds-due:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-100, #2d4f8a); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-due-w { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:600 15px 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; color:var(--text-primary, #1d1915); } .ds-seal-sm { width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:1.5px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal, #b3342a) 16%, transparent); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--seal, #b3342a), 0 0 0 1.5px var(--pigment-hoe, #e3b12f); } .ds-due-arrow { margin-left:auto; display:flex; color:var(--text-warning, #674a05); transition:transform .15s; }

components.name: Rating Keys

components.css: .ds-rate { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 180px); gap:8px; } .ds-key { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; padding:10px 14px; text-align:left; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgb(29 25 21 / .12)); background:var(--surface-1, #f8f5ee); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .12s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.3,.64,1); } .ds-key:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong, rgb(29 25 21 / .24)); } .ds-key:active { transform:scale(.975); transition-duration:60ms; } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-100, #2d4f8a); outline-offset:1px; } .ds-key-top { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:600 15px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; color:var(--text-primary, #1d1915); } .ds-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:2px; } .ds-key-top kbd { margin-left:auto; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; height:20px; min-width:20px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--border, rgb(29 25 21 / .12)); font:500 11px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; color:var(--text-muted, #6a6055); } .ds-key-iv { padding-left:16px; font:400 13px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text-secondary, #4a4239); }

components.name: Seal (đóng dấu)
components.description: The signature: carved 5x5 seal-script chop in four stages; bloom presses with the 440ms ink-down on hover here.
components.css: :host { display:flex; gap:20px; align-items:center; } .ds-seal { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:44px; height:44px; margin-right:20px; border-radius:3px; color:var(--seal, #b3342a); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--seal, #b3342a), inset 0 0 0 4.5px transparent, inset 0 0 0 5.5px var(--seal, #b3342a); } .ds-seal svg { width:100%; height:100%; } .ds-seal-seed { color:var(--text-muted, #6a6055); box-shadow:none; outline:1.5px dashed var(--border-stronger, rgb(29 25 21 / .45)); outline-offset:-1.5px; } .ds-seal-sprout { background:linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal, #b3342a) 38%, transparent) 50%, transparent 50%); } .ds-seal-thirsty { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--seal, #b3342a) 16%, transparent); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--seal, #b3342a), 0 0 0 2px var(--pigment-hoe, #e3b12f); } .ds-seal-bloom { background:var(--seal, #b3342a); color:var(--seal-ink, #fffaf2); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--seal, #b3342a), inset 0 0 0 4.5px var(--seal-ink, #fffaf2); transform:rotate(-3deg); } .ds-seal-bloom:hover { animation:ds-press 440ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-press { 0% { transform:scale(1.6) rotate(-10deg); opacity:.25; } 55% { transform:scale(.95) rotate(-3deg); opacity:1; } 100% { transform:scale(1) rotate(-3deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seal-bloom:hover { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Lượm is a Vietnamese folk woodblock print (tranh Đông Hồ) turned into a Mac app: flat pressed pigment on a warm paper ground, carved black-ink lettering, and a son-red seal that stamps each word as the learner makes it theirs. Colour arrives as solid blocks of a small named pigment set, never as tints or glows; edges are cut, not softened; a single hairline weight separates things. The shell is an ink-black rail beside a paper page, so the app reads as one printed sheet with its ink block on the left.

Density is calm and editorial: one headline in the carved slab face states what is due, one son-red action sits beside it, and everything else steps down in Be Vietnam Pro. Dark mode is the same print inverted onto ink: the paper becomes near-black (`dark-paper`), the ink becomes paper-cream, and the pigments lift in lightness to stay AA. Both themes are first-class.

The world rejects the calm grey SaaS sidebar with a single jade accent: no glass, no decorative gradients, no soft drop-shadowed cards at rest.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rail + paper page; the page is one sheet with hairline divisions.
Five named pigments (son, hoa hòe, gỉ đồng, chàm, than tre ink), each with a fixed meaning.
Bitter (carved slab) for anything a word or a page is called; Be Vietnam Pro for everything you operate.
Small cut radii (2–8px); flat at rest; shadows only on things that float.
The seal (đóng dấu) is the signature: a carved 5×5 seal-script chop that marks a word's stage and presses on Good.

rules.name: The Pigment Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each pigment says one thing everywhere: son = act / mastered, hoa hòe = due, gỉ đồng = growing / good, chàm = link / info / focus, ink = structure. Skill blocks on Play reuse the same map (Spelling son, Recall đồng, Listening chàm, Speed hòe, Typing ink).

rules.name: The One Red Block Rule
rules.body: A screen carries one son-red action block. Everything else that is clickable is secondary (hairline), ghost, or an indigo link.

rules.name: The Flat Pigment Rule
rules.body: Pigment is laid as a solid fill or as a hard-stop band (the highlighter, the half-inked sprout seal). No soft blends, no colour-to-colour gradients.

rules.name: The Carved Name Rule
rules.body: If it is a word being learned or the name of a place, page, game or story, set it in Bitter. If it is something you press or read past, set it in Be Vietnam Pro.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and labels are sentence case at normal tracking; the print's lettering does not shout.

rules.name: The Pressed Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the sheet hovers. Hover changes the fill or the hairline; the only lift is for an object that is literally above the page.

dos: Do edit the palette in `scripts/gen-theme.py` and regenerate; read its contrast printout and keep every text pair ≥ 4.5:1 in both themes.
Do keep one son-red block per screen and route every other action to secondary, ghost or an indigo link.
Do use pigments by meaning: hoa hòe for due, gỉ đồng for growing / good, chàm for links / focus, son for act / mastered.
Do set words being learned and page / game / story names in Bitter; everything operable in Be Vietnam Pro.
Do separate with one 1px hairline and tonal steps of paper; keep corners at 2–8px.
Do mark word progress with the Seal and its four stages, and press it on Good with the 440ms ink-down.
Do design light and dark together; dark is the print inverted onto ink, not a grey theme.
donts: Don't edit `src/renderer/src/styles/envi-theme.css` by hand; it is generated.
Don't use frosted glass or backdrop blur on surfaces of the sheet.
Don't blend pigments into gradients; hard-stop bands (highlighter, sprout seal) are the only gradient form.
Don't put shadows on cards or tiles at rest; hover changes fill or hairline, not elevation.
Don't add a second accent outside the five pigments, or a calm grey sidebar with one jade accent.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels or kickers above headings.
